purpose: Reusable official membership certificate template for all approved RLS Association members.
source: User-supplied reference image from 2026-11-10. Preserve its layout, ornaments, colors, Russian landmarks, flag, upper-left journal emblem, and lower-center seal placement.

fixed_visuals.border: ornate double navy-and-gold academic frame with decorative corners
fixed_visuals.upper_left: journal seal-derived emblem adapted for association certificate
fixed_visuals.left: Saint Basil's Cathedral illustration and laurel
fixed_visuals.lower_center: fixed journal seal extracted from the supplied Word document

data_rules.printed_name_source: rls_profiles.full_name — always print the member’s registered first and last name; never substitute display_name.
data_rules.membership_start_date_source: rls_profiles.created_at — the same field displayed as the membership date on the public member profile
data_rules.member_number_assignment: Database trigger assigns a global sequence number when membership_status first changes to approved. Existing assigned numbers are immutable.
data_rules.member_number_format: Six-digit global serial; Persian numerals on Persian certificates (000001, 000002, ...)
data_rules.member_number_lifecycle: Pending applications have no member number. Numbers are assigned only on approval, are unique, are never reused, and gaps are acceptable.
data_rules.issue_date_source: Current Asia/Tehran calendar date at the moment the certificate is generated
data_rules.authenticity_method: QR opens the member's public profile. The profile displays the same membership date, membership group, six-digit member number, and approved membership status. There is no separate validation-code field or verification page.
data_rules.numbers: Render Persian numerals in Persian copy. The QR contains only the direct profile URL.

print_notes: Use actual member profile data only; never invent dates or serial numbers.
The certificate membership date must equal the date shown on the public member profile and is sourced from rls_profiles.created_at.
Do not print a separate validation code.
The QR code must open the member's direct public profile, not a standalone validation page.
The QR destination profile must display the member number, membership group, membership date, and approved status.
Only approved members receive a member number and a downloadable certificate.
Member numbers use one global database sequence, are six digits, immutable, unique, and never recycled.
Keep the master design, palette, layout, association emblem, and Word-document journal-seal placement identical across members.
Keep the QR code readable with a white quiet zone.
Use A4 landscape (297 × 210 mm), 300 DPI, and print-color-adjust: exact.
